# RRS + HORMONES
A helper function fits univariate linear models of RRS on each hormone (RRS ~ hormone_x), returning both raw and standardized effect estimates with confidence intervals and R². Hormone measures are merged onto the RRS metadata by PID, and each hormone variable is run through this function in turn. The resulting association table is then FDR-corrected (BH) and sorted by adjusted p-value to highlight hormones most strongly related to the RRS.

```{r}
# univariate regression helper for hormones: RRS ~ hormone_x
run_regression_hormone <- function(var, data) {
  df <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(RRS, !!sym(var)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(x = !!sym(var)) %>%
    mutate(RRS = as.numeric(RRS),
           x  = as.numeric(x)) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.))

  # raw model
  m_raw <- lm(RRS ~ x, data = df)
  sm_raw <- summary(m_raw)
  coefs_raw <- as.data.frame(sm_raw$coefficients)

  # standardized model
  df$y_std <- as.numeric(scale(df$RRS))
  df$x_std <- as.numeric(scale(df$x))
  m_std <- lm(y_std ~ x_std, data = df)
  sm_std <- summary(m_std)
  coefs_std <- as.data.frame(sm_std$coefficients)

  out <- data.frame(
    Variable = var,
    Term = var,
    Sample_Size = nrow(df),
    Coefficient = unname(coefs_raw["x", "Estimate"]),
    Std_Error = unname(coefs_raw["x", "Std. Error"]),
    T_value = unname(coefs_raw["x", "t value"]),
    P_value = unname(coefs_raw["x", "Pr(>|t|)"]),
    R_squared = sm_raw$r.squared,
    Std_Coefficient = unname(coefs_std["x_std", "Estimate"]),
    Std_SE = unname(coefs_std["x_std", "Std. Error"]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  out$CI_lower <- out$Coefficient - 1.96 * out$Std_Error
  out$CI_upper <- out$Coefficient  + 1.96 * out$Std_Error
  out$Std_CI_lower <- out$Std_Coefficient - 1.96 * out$Std_SE
  out$Std_CI_upper <- out$Std_Coefficient + 1.96 * out$Std_SE
  out$Type <- "Continuous"

  out
}

hormone_vars <- c(setdiff(names(hormone_data),
          c("PID", "SAMPLE.ID", "Sample.bar.code", "Tube.label", "Sample.volume..µL.")), "E2_sqrt")

E2_data <- read.csv("Data/E2 Data/Analysis Data/E2_Data_ED26M_150_4-16-2026.csv") %>%

    hormone_data %>% mutate(PID = as.character(PID)),
    by = "PID") %>%

    E2_data %>% mutate(PID = as.character(PID)),

hormone_results_df <- purrr::map_dfr(hormone_vars, run_regression_hormone,data = metadata_hormones) %>%

hormone_results_export <- hormone_results_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Variable, P_value, FDR, Coefficient, T_value, Std_Error, 
                R_squared, Std_Coefficient, Std_SE, CI_lower, CI_upper, 
                Std_CI_lower, Std_CI_upper, Type, Sample_Size) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    `Hormone` = Variable,
    `P value` = P_value,
    `FDR` = FDR,
    `Coefficient` = Coefficient,
    `t value` = T_value,
    `Standard error` = Std_Error,
    `R squared` = R_squared,
    `Standardized coefficient` = Std_Coefficient,
    `Standardized SE` = Std_SE,
    `CI lower` = CI_lower,
    `CI upper` = CI_upper,
    `Std CI lower` = Std_CI_lower,
    `Std CI upper` = Std_CI_upper, 
    `Sample Size` = Sample_Size) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ format_num(.x)))
```

## Adjusted model 
```{r}
run_regression_hormone_adj <- function(var, data) {
  
  df <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(RRS, !!sym(var), Age, BMI, Gender) %>%
    dplyr::rename(x = !!sym(var)) %>%
    mutate(
      RRS = as.numeric(RRS),
      x = as.numeric(x)
    ) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.))

  # adjusted model
  m_raw <- lm(RRS ~ x + Age + BMI + Gender, data = df)
  sm_raw <- summary(m_raw)
  coefs_raw <- as.data.frame(sm_raw$coefficients)

  # standardized model
  df$y_std <- as.numeric(scale(df$RRS))
  df$x_std <- as.numeric(scale(df$x))
  m_std <- lm(y_std ~ x_std, data = df)
  sm_std <- summary(m_std)
  coefs_std <- as.data.frame(sm_std$coefficients)

  out <- data.frame(
    Variable = var,
    Term = var,
    Sample_Size = nrow(df),
    Coefficient = unname(coefs_raw["x", "Estimate"]),
    Std_Error = unname(coefs_raw["x", "Std. Error"]),
    T_value = unname(coefs_raw["x", "t value"]),
    P_value = unname(coefs_raw["x", "Pr(>|t|)"]),
    R_squared = sm_raw$r.squared,
    Std_Coefficient = unname(coefs_std["x_std", "Estimate"]),
    Std_SE = unname(coefs_std["x_std", "Std. Error"]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  out$CI_lower <- out$Coefficient - 1.96 * out$Std_Error
  out$CI_upper <- out$Coefficient  + 1.96 * out$Std_Error
  out$Std_CI_lower <- out$Std_Coefficient - 1.96 * out$Std_SE
  out$Std_CI_upper <- out$Std_Coefficient + 1.96 * out$Std_SE
  out$Type <- "Continuous"

  out
}
hormone_vars <- c(
  setdiff(names(hormone_data),
          c("PID", "SAMPLE.ID", "Sample.bar.code", "Tube.label", "Sample.volume..µL.")),
  "E2_sqrt"
)


metadata_hormones <- metadata_hormones %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% mutate(PID = as.character(PID)), by = "PID")

hormone_results_df <- purrr::map_dfr(
  hormone_vars,
  run_regression_hormone_adj,
  data = metadata_hormones
) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Variable != "E2") %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(FDR) 

hormone_results_export_adj <- hormone_results_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Variable, P_value, FDR, Coefficient, T_value, Std_Error, 
                R_squared, Std_Coefficient, Std_SE, CI_lower, CI_upper, 
                Std_CI_lower, Std_CI_upper, Type, Sample_Size) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    `Hormone` = Variable,
    `P value` = P_value,
    `FDR` = FDR,
    `Coefficient` = Coefficient,
    `t value` = T_value,
    `Standard error` = Std_Error,
    `R squared` = R_squared,
    `Standardized coefficient` = Std_Coefficient,
    `Standardized SE` = Std_SE,
    `CI lower` = CI_lower,
    `CI upper` = CI_upper,
    `Std CI lower` = Std_CI_lower,
    `Std CI upper` = Std_CI_upper, 
    `Sample Size` = Sample_Size) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ format_num(.x)))


write.csv(hormone_results_export, "RRS Correlates/ED Hormones RRS Linear Regression Results Adjusted (age, BMI, sex).csv")
```

### Forest Plot
```{r}

hormone_labels <- c("Cortisol" = "Cortisol", "Corticosterone" = "Corticosterone", "Cortisone" = "Cortisone", "X11.Deoxycorticosterone" = "11-Deoxycorticosterone", "X11.Deoxycortisol" = "11-Deoxycortisol", "Etiocholanolone" = "Etiocholanolone", "Androsterone" = "Androsterone", "DHEAS" = "DHEAS", "DHT" = "DHT", "Testosterone" = "Testosterone", "X17.OHP" = "17-OHP", "DHEA" = "DHEA", "E1" = "E1", "Aldosterone" = "Aldosterone", "Androstenedione" = "Androstenedione", "Progesterone" = "Progesterone", "E2_sqrt" = "E2")


# start from the object you actually created
hormones_forest_data <- hormone_results_df %>%
    filter(Variable != "E2") %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = recode(Variable, !!!hormone_labels),
    Sig = if_else(!is.na(FDR) & FDR < 0.05, "sig", "nonsig"),
    Sig = factor(Sig, levels = c("nonsig", "sig")),
    Color = if_else(Sig == "sig", "#2698B1", "grey30")
  ) %>%
  arrange(Std_Coefficient) %>%
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = unique(Variable))) 
hormone_forest_plot <- ggplot(hormones_forest_data, aes(x = Std_Coefficient, y = Variable)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Std_CI_lower, xmax = Std_CI_upper, color = Color),
                 height = 0.45, linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Color), size = 5) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.6, 0.6), breaks = c(-0.5, 0, 0.5)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "black",
             linewidth = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Effect size (β)",
       y = "Hormone Levels at the ED") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),

    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12.5, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1))

ggsave(hormone_forest_plot, filename = "Figures/ED Hormones RRS Regression Forest Plot v2.jpg", width = 4.5, height = 6, dpi = 500)


```

```{r}
regression_results_combined <- bind_rows(

      T_value = as.numeric(`t value`),
      P_value = as.numeric(`P value`),
      FDR = as.numeric(FDR),
      R_squared = as.numeric(`R squared`),
      Standardized_Coefficient = as.numeric(`Standardized coefficient`),
      Standardized_SE = as.numeric(`Standardized SE`),
      CI_lower = as.numeric(`CI lower`),
      CI_upper = as.numeric(`CI upper`),
      Standardized_CI_lower = as.numeric(`Std CI lower`),
      Standardized_CI_upper = as.numeric(`Std CI upper`),
      Type = Type,
      Sample_Size = as.integer(as.numeric(`Sample Size`))
    ),
  
  hormone_results_export_adj %>%
    transmute(
      Variable = Hormone,
      Analysis = "Hormones",
      Model = "Adjusted",
      Coefficient = as.numeric(Coefficient),
      Standard_Error = as.numeric(`Standard error`),
      T_value = as.numeric(`t value`),
      P_value = as.numeric(`P value`),
      FDR = as.numeric(FDR),
      R_squared = as.numeric(`R squared`),
      Standardized_Coefficient = as.numeric(`Standardized coefficient`),
      Standardized_SE = as.numeric(`Standardized SE`),
      CI_lower = as.numeric(`CI lower`),
      CI_upper = as.numeric(`CI upper`),
      Standardized_CI_lower = as.numeric(`Std CI lower`),
      Standardized_CI_upper = as.numeric(`Std CI upper`),
      Type = Type,
      Sample_Size = as.integer(as.numeric(`Sample Size`))
    )
) %>%
  arrange(Analysis, Variable, Model) %>%
  dplyr::select(Analysis, Variable, Model, everything()) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ format_num(.x)))

write.csv(regression_results_combined, "RRS Correlates/Combined RRS Associations.csv")
```
